name: Fashion Komyushou-kun to Business Bocchi-chan
original_name: ファッションコミュ障くんとビジネスボッチちゃん
source:
Fashion Komyushou-kun just wants to make money.
He wants to work more hours and more shifts.

However, his current part-time job at a convenience store does not allow him to work more shifts.

At a loss, Fashion Komyushou-kun decides to quit his current part-time job at the convenience store in order to find another, more profitable one.

However, the convenience store he currently worked at was almost entirely managed by him alone.

Not wanting him to quit his part-time job, the manager and the junior staff came up with a plan. That is, a grand strategy to keep Fashion Komyushou-kun on board.
